question: A alone can complete a work in 18 days and B alone in 14 days. Starting with A, they work on alternate days. The total work will be completed in:
solution:
**Given:-** A alone can complete in 18 days whereas B in 14 days,

**To find:- **Total time taken by both when they work on alternate days

**Concept used:-** work done = efficiency × time and when two people work alternatively then one work in a day other work next day.

**Calculations:- **Let** the total work = LCM(18 , 14)**

⇒Total work = 126 units

⇒Work done by A in one day = (126)/(18) = 7 units

⇒Work done by B in one day = (126)/(14) = 9 units

A and B are working on alternate days,

⇒In 2 days of working (7 + 9) units of work will be completed

⇒**Total work done by both A and B in 2 days = 16 units**

This means they will be finishing 112 units of work in 14 days

⇒On15th day 7 units will be done by A,

then, **the left work will after 15th day = 126 - (112 + 7) = 7 units**

The time taken by B to complete the 7 unit of work = (7)/(9) days

⇒Total time taken by both A and B = 15 days + (7)/(9) days = rm15(7)/(9)days

 

**.·.Time taken by A and B to complete the work alternatively is rm15(7)/(9)days**
